content.summary: Taylor Ruiz (TUTOR) reports that item AUD-777 has no audible sound from the start, although the timer runs normally to the end and the local download is also completely silent. Taylor asks where to record this. Riley Chen (QA_TUTOR) replies that the download was also silent for them and advises using the media-input quality flag and keeping the original clip attached. A TEAM_LEAD (U9101) endorsed Riley's reply with a white_check_mark reaction.
content.central_question: Where should the silent audio on AUD-777 (no audible sound from the start, silent local download as well) be recorded?

attributed_agent1_resolution.rationale: The root asks only where to record the silent-audio problem. Riley Chen's reply directly answers this: use the media-input quality flag and keep the original clip attached. The reply is from a QA_TUTOR and carries a white_check_mark from U9101, who is mapped to TEAM_LEAD in reactor_roles, so the endorsement requirement is met. No part of the requested guidance is left open.

k:pilot-media-input-quality-faq@1.1:0030.excerpt:
## Silent input
If a local copy is confirmed to be silent and the player advances normally, preserve the sample and use the media-input quality flag. When the task ID or the local playback check is missing, ask for it before assigning a disposition.

k:pilot-audio-incident-triage@1.3:3b2b70.excerpt:
## Playback failures
For a reproducible player freeze after seeking, collect task IDs, browser versions, and reproduction steps. Send one scoped engineering incident for the affected player reports. If a downloaded clip is silent while the player counter and seeking work, follow the media-input quality procedure for that clip.
